_comment: Modello di mutazioni della tesi precedente (Tabella 1.1, a-k). Usato dal llm-generator in modalita parametrica: per ogni tipo si chiede all'LLM di applicare QUEL tipo, scegliendo lui l'elemento.

types.name: Attribute Value Modification
types.description: Change the VALUE of an existing attribute on an element, keeping the same attribute name.

types.name: Attribute Removal
types.description: Remove an existing (non-essential) attribute from an element.

types.name: Attribute Identifier Modification
types.description: Rename an existing attribute (change the attribute name, keep its value).
types.note: Nell'app potrebbe non esserci alcun id nativo: in tal caso il tipo e' poco/non applicabile (come nella tesi precedente).

types.name: Text Content Modification
types.description: Change the visible text content of an element.

types.name: Text Content Removal
types.description: Remove/empty the visible text content of an element.

types.name: HTML Tag Movement (within a container)
types.description: Reorder an element among its siblings inside the same parent container.

types.name: HTML Tag Movement (any point of the HTML tree)
types.description: Move an element to a different position elsewhere in the template tree (different parent).

types.name: HTML Tag Movement (between two templates)
types.description: Move an element out of this template into another component template.
types.after:
<template1>
</template1>  (l'elemento viene spostato in un altro template)
types.note: Richiede due template: difficile in modalita per-file con un solo template fornito. Da gestire a parte o segnalare come non applicabile in questo contesto.

types.name: HTML Tag Removal
types.description: Remove an element's tag but keep its text/children (unwrap).

types.name: HTML Tag Type Modification
types.description: Change the tag name of an element (e.g. div -> section), keeping attributes and content.

types.name: HTML Tag Insertion
types.description: Insert a new wrapper/container tag around an existing element (add a hierarchy level).
